name: prompt-upgrade
description: Turns a rough prompt into a great one before it is sent: up to three multiple-choice questions, a rewrite, and the original beside the upgrade in a pane. Nothing runs until you press Run. /better <prompt>, /better on|off|history.

questionModel.title: Model that asks the questions
questionModel.description: A fast model, one short call per upgrade.

minWords.title: Shortest prompt taken in automatic mode
minWords.description: Shorter ones ("yes", "keep going") go straight through.
